score.interpretation: Strong exact-SHA directed diagnostic that repairs the four main M345 evidence gaps and establishes 1.000x under equal 8-bank/1024-bit peak bandwidth. It is not equal-area/equal-service-capacity, trace-representative, physical or complete-FC2 evidence.

independent_cycle_recalculation.definition: One posedge monitor records accepted header and accepted token_done edge ordinals; inclusive cycles=end_edge-start_edge+1.
independent_cycle_recalculation.conclusion: The four directed nonzero shapes and zero-event case all independently support exactly 1.000x at the monitored boundary.

fairness_audit.baseline_service_capacity: eight M219 lanes, aggregate O64/FIFO32 plus atomic result/done join
fairness_audit.reason: The periodic allow gates are identical, but bundling, outstanding topology, per-bank readiness and selected response identities differ by architecture. This does not invalidate the measured ratio; it limits the wording to equal peak bandwidth under common allow schedules.

transaction_numeric_and_memory_audit.response_tuple_key: block,slice,channel with bank implied by channel[2:0]
transaction_numeric_and_memory_audit.conclusion: PASS: both architectures consume the same active bank-word multiset and exact per-lane signed weights and commit the same Acc24 results.

out_of_order_scoreboard_audit.younger_before_older_definition: An accepted response generation is greater than at least one other still-live generation in the same candidate pool or baseline bank pool.

m345_finding_disposition.M345-P1-01_equal_bandwidth: REPAIRED_FOR_PEAK_BANDWIDTH: K1x8 can issue and return eight 128-bit bank words per cycle, matching K8's 1024-bit peak. Equal area/service capacity remains false.
m345_finding_disposition.M345-P1-02_inert_service_sva: REPAIRED: M218 and all eight M219 service SVA modules are bound, appear in assert.report and have the required nonzero covers.
m345_finding_disposition.M345-P1-03_ooo_and_multiset: REPAIRED: per-slot generation scoreboards observe true younger-before-still-live-older responses and exact request/response tuple multisets match.
m345_finding_disposition.M345-P2-01_cycle_race: REPAIRED: one posedge monitor owns both cycle endpoints.
m345_finding_disposition.remaining_m345_scope_limits: Synthetic rather than frozen 120-record trace; incomplete FC2; no physical macro, PPA or system evidence.

m342_5p281_disposition.original_denominator: one globally serialized K1 bundled-memory request/response path with 128-bit active payload per accepted request
withdrawn_meanings: grouping/control-only speedup against an eight-bank 1024-bit/cycle baseline
complete FC2, FFN, physical, system or headline speedup
m342_5p281_disposition.retained_meaning: M342 remains a reproducible directed bundled-interface K8-versus-serialized-K1 observation under its exact M345 qualifier. It is not deleted, but it is superseded by M349 for equal-bandwidth comparison.
m342_5p281_disposition.paper_table_rule: Use 1.000x in the equal-peak-bandwidth control/coalescing row. If 5.281x is retained at all, place it only in a separately labeled serialized-port sensitivity row, never as the main accelerator advantage.

findings.title: Equal peak bandwidth is not equal area or equal service/queue resource
findings.evidence: The K8 candidate uses one M218 O8/FIFO4 service; K1x8 uses eight M219 services with aggregate O64/FIFO32 plus an eight-way atomic result/done join.
findings.impact: The 1.000x directed cycle ratio is valid against a deliberately strong baseline, but it cannot establish throughput/mm2, area savings, energy savings or a same-resource architectural comparison.
findings.required_fix: Synthesize both alternatives, include memory interfaces and join logic, and report area/Fmax/throughput-per-area; optionally add an aggregate-O8 shared-control K1x8 sensitivity.

findings.title: The receipt overstates trajectory identity
findings.evidence: Both runs restart the same periodic request/response/result/done allow functions and use the same payload/multiset, but accepted request/response timing and identities differ because K8 bundles banks while K1x8 has independent per-bank outstanding state.
findings.impact: The `same_raw_weight_request_response_result_and_done_trajectories=true` field should be read as common offered content and allow schedules, not identical realized internal traces.
findings.required_fix: Rename the field to common_payload_and_external_allow_schedules and publish per-architecture realized stall-cause/issue traces.

findings.title: Performance coverage remains synthetic
findings.evidence: Timing uses B={1,2,4,8} deterministic shapes and one zero-event shape, not the frozen 120-record H67 FC2 cohort or event-density strata.
findings.impact: Exactly 1.000x is established for this directed suite, not all FC2 activity distributions.
findings.required_fix: Replay the frozen FC2 descriptor/group stream with the same equal-bandwidth contract and report distributions, not only five points.

findings.title: Several service/frontend corner covers remain zero or outside the required gate
findings.evidence: Flush, most per-lane protocol-fault/stale paths and several M216 terminal-chain/partial-close/same-cycle-done-load covers are zero; attacks cover illegal header, spurious response and one midflight POR per architecture.
findings.impact: The required clean/service paths are nonvacuous, but recovery and corner-protocol completeness is not exhaustive.
findings.required_fix: Add a directed protocol/recovery matrix or explicit waivers for integration-impossible paths.

findings.title: Logical L4 memories do not provide physical PPA or energy fairness
findings.evidence: Both models implement ideal logical banks and deterministic weights; there are no SRAM macros, address decode, interconnect timing, DC/Fmax, SAIF or PTPX results.
findings.impact: The cycle diagnostic cannot be promoted to physical speedup, energy or DATE PPA evidence.
findings.required_fix: Map matched bank macros/ports, synthesize both datapaths, run timing and activity-based power, and include interface/control energy per token.

next_gates.dc: GO_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY: synthesize candidate and baseline with identical constraints and explicit memory black boxes; do not call the result paper PPA without macros and equal-resource normalization.
next_gates.formality: GO_AFTER_DC: separately prove M342 K8 and M349 K1x8 RTL-to-netlist equivalence with pinned parameters and no unresolved points.
next_gates.ptpx: NO_GO_UNTIL_DC_FORMALITY_AND_REPRESENTATIVE_SAIF: use the frozen trace, matched allow schedules, macro/interface energy and mapping coverage.
